question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Participate in a mock interview to prepare for ______ on your feet and formulating answers under pressure.
solution:
The correct answer is "thinking."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 
The reason for using **"thinking"** in the blank is to convey the idea that the mock interview will help individuals practice and prepare for the skill of quick and spontaneous thinking.

 
 
• 
 
It emphasizes the ability to respond promptly and effectively, especially in situations that require on-the-spot decision-making or problem-solving.

 
 
• 
 
The phrase **"thinking on your feet"** means being able to think quickly and make decisions in real-time. (शीघ्रता से सोचने और वास्तविक समय में निर्णय लेने में सक्षम होना)

 
 
• 
 
**Example**: *During the presentation, she had to **think on her feet**__ when the projector suddenly stopped working.*

 
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Participate in a mock interview to prepare for __**thinking**__ on your feet and formulating answers under pressure.*
